title: Starfall Observatory: The Vanishing Comet Plate
description: On the clearest night in a decade, the glass negative of a returning comet vanished from the mountain observatory. A locked dome, a borrowed key, a debt cable, and one impossible alibi point in different directions. Reconstruct the final quarter-hour before the lecture begins.

truth.summary: Dr. Elias Vane borrowed the duplicate dome key, removed the comet negative at 22:45, and hid it inside a discarded plate sleeve in the darkroom. He planned to sell the image to a publisher to settle a private debt. Ada's sighting, the dome-key register, the blue-silica boot match, and his contradicted archive alibi converge on him. Mira's generator grease and presence near the dome are innocent: the dynamo stayed steady and she remained at her station.
timeline: 21:50 - Ada seals the comet negative into the padded plate case before the public lecture.
22:20 - Elias signs out the duplicate dome key from the chart-archive register.
22:35 - Elias receives a cable from a publisher demanding repayment for an advance.
22:45 - Elias removes the negative from the plate case and carries it through the dome.
22:52 - Ada sees Elias leaving the dome with an empty sleeve.
23:00 - The observatory opens its lecture room; the negative is found missing.
